[[File:Livet_Tower.png|thumb|right|180px|The Eternal Flame, contained in the Livet Tower, burned [[Standard day/Legends|day]] and night.]]
The '''Eternal Flame''' was a never-ending light contained in the [[Livet Tower/Legends|Livet Tower]]. The tower was situated near the [[Theed Funeral Temple/Legends|Funeral Temple]] in [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. The flame, easily visible from the whole city, was a constant reminder to the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] of their own [[Death/Legends|mortality]] and their duty to live in harmony. During [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] processions, the mourners used to gather around the Eternal Flame for a moment of contemplation, shortly after the [[Cremation/Legends|cremation]] of the dead in the Funeral Temple.
